laws.counterexample_requirement: a byte-exact and depth-exact comparison (equal-parameter organs exchanging the same two specs) that still separates the policies
laws.text: On Qwen3-0.6B at matched complete EBPW, the monotone-ramp allocation arms do not share a bit-depth multiset, so a UNIFORM/GLOBAL/LOCAL difference is not attributable to organ ordering.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a second body where local anatomy's margin on the disagreeing pair is LARGE (local lost here with a 1.42-point margin against global's 6.07, i.e. local was near-random exactly where it disagreed), or any equal-parameter pair where local wins against a large global margin. Also reopens on the two undecided pairs (o_proj|q_proj, down_proj|up_proj) separating at another cheap/rich spec.
laws.text: G021, byte-exact and depth-exact: on Qwen3-0.6B the GLOBAL organ-structure prior predicted which organ of an equal-parameter pair tolerates being crushed on 3 of 3 decided pairs; this body's own LOCAL anatomy got 2 of 3. On the single pair where they disagree (down_proj vs gate_proj) GLOBAL was right: crushing gate_proj costs ppl 5.0099 and PASSES the conjunction, crushing down_proj costs 5.9605 and fails on diversity r4 0.798. Local measurement did NOT earn authority over the global prior here.

laws.counterexample_requirement: an architecture with no two organs of equal parameter count, where the mirror design cannot be built and some other equalisation is needed
laws.text: Comparing allocation POLICIES through a monotone bit/group search is confounded: each policy takes whatever bit-depth multiset hits the byte budget under its own monotonicity constraint, and on Qwen3-0.6B minimum bit depth separates perplexity almost completely (min=2 arms 6.76-12.84, min=3 arms 5.43-6.17, min=4 arms 5.23-5.45). Compare organs of IDENTICAL parameter count exchanging the same two specs instead: byte-exact, EBPW-exact, depth-exact, assignment the only variable.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a MoE family whose per-expert spectrum is materially below its matched null, i.e. a negative deficit outside measurement scatter
laws.text: Cross-expert LINEAR sharing is matched-null: per-expert spectra are indistinguishable from their same-shape null across six MoE families, 64 to 512 experts, in both storage layouts (kimi_vl +0.000%, lfm2_moe -0.007%, qwen3_moe +0.0%). SKIP RULE: do not build a cross-expert shared linear basis by default. Run the cheap null-calibrated expert-stack anatomy first and only build if a family sits materially BELOW its null.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a representation family where weight-space error predicts held-out capability better than random ranking AND better than static anatomy, measured with those two controls present
laws.text: Weight reconstruction error MISRANKS capability. On O003, PQ achieved 45% lower reconstruction error than affine at fewer bits and WORSE capability. Demote reconstruction error, weight cosine and norm statistics to cheap filters and diagnostics: they may prioritise candidates, they may never accept one. Only the capability conjunction accepts.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a body where a monotone organ-weighted ramp beats uniform at matched complete EBPW and passes the conjunction, with the arms sharing a bit-depth multiset so the comparison is not the confound in LAW003
laws.text: The global organ-structure prior is NOT a universal allocation weighting. Spending a matched complete-EBPW budget unequally along the global deficit order did not beat spending it uniformly and did not pass the conjunction. Structural redundancy is not behavioural compressibility. Note the refinement from the mirror swap: the global ORDER still predicts pairwise organ tolerance 3/3, so what failed is the RAMP, not the ranking.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a body whose non-MLP persistent payload is small enough that zeroing the MLP crosses 1.0, or a representation that reduces the non-MLP payload itself
laws.text: MLP-only Gravity cannot reach <=1.0 complete EBPW. Driving the ENTIRE MLP to zero persistent bytes still leaves approximately 1.545 complete EBPW. The <=1.0 target is outside the MLP-only search space as a matter of arithmetic, so attention, DeltaNet, state and cross-organ representation are not optional if that target is serious.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a diversity metric whose range makes 3 x dense a reachable bar, where the cap would then be doing nothing
laws.text: The diversity half of the capability gate must be capped inside the metric's own range: min(3 x dense, midpoint(dense, 1.0)). The uncapped 3 x dense bar was 1.0857 for a median 4-gram repeat bounded at 1.0 -- nothing could fail it, so the conjunction was perplexity wearing a second name and visibly repetitive arms were recorded as passing. Any receipt whose stored verdict predates this is STALE and must be re-derived, not cited.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a body where the structural ordering predicts measured per-organ sensitivity with tau that survives per-byte normalisation, or a perturbation size at which the negative-sensitivity organs turn positive
laws.text: Organ structure -- global prior OR local anatomy -- is a WEAK predictor of behavioural tolerance. Two independent probes on Qwen3-0.6B agree on every pair they both decide, and together they put the global prior at 3/5 and local anatomy at 2/5 on which organ of a pair tolerates being crushed; chance is 2.5/5. Kendall tau between measured per-organ sensitivity and the structural ordering is 0.238 (global) and 0.048 (local), and once the delta is normalised per megabyte saved the signal INVERTS to -0.048 and -0.238 -- i.e. most of the apparent structural signal is organ SIZE. Two organs (o_proj, gate_proj) have NEGATIVE sensitivity: crushing them to q3-g64 lowered perplexity below the q4-g64 base. Use measured behavioural sensitivity, not anatomy, to allocate.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a shipped body whose embedding and other non-linear payload are themselves compressed, or a tied/factored vocabulary that removes the embedding as the dominant term
laws.text: A shipped purpose-built low-bit body independently confirms G012's shape. microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T stores its linears at 2.000 bits per weight -- packed [640,6912] against a logical [2560,6912], four ternary values per byte plus a bf16 per-tensor scale; 1.58 is the information content of a ternary value, not the storage. Its complete EBPW is 3.908, and 55.7% of every persistent byte is ONE bf16 embedding tensor at 16 bpw, against 44.2% for all the ternary linears combined. Driving every linear to zero bytes still leaves ~2.18 complete EBPW; driving the embedding to zero still leaves ~1.73. A dedicated ternary design by a major lab does not reach <=1.0 complete EBPW, and the binding constraint is the same non-linear payload G012 identified.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a second body where a gentle depth-controlled tilt along the global order fails the conjunction while uniform passes, or a budget on this body where uniform also passes and the tilt buys nothing
laws.text: The GLOBAL organ-structure order IS a usable allocation prior when the tilt is gentle and depth-controlled. Four arms at 247,730,784 organ bytes each, the three tilted ones sharing one bit-depth multiset: GLOBAL_ANATOMY is the ONLY arm to survive the capability conjunction (ppl 5.5520, r4 0.4135), beating UNIFORM on the gate (ppl 5.2278 but r4 0.7103, FAIL) despite losing to it on likelihood. The earlier G017/G021 failures were the RAMP'S DEPTH, not the ordering: those arms reached q2 and q3-g128, this tilt is q3-g32 on three organs and q4 on four. Diversity is where the tilt pays -- r4 0.7103 -> 0.4135 against a dense 0.3619.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a body where the one-at-a-time ordering and the measured full-allocation ordering agree, or a joint/interaction-aware sensitivity probe that does compose
laws.text: One-organ-at-a-time behavioural sensitivity does NOT compose into a multi-organ allocation. The map is real -- allocating by it beats allocating AGAINST it by 0.6712 ppl at identical bytes and identical bit depths, so the negative control holds -- yet the anatomy-ordered arm still beat the sensitivity-ordered arm and was the only one to pass the gate. Measuring each organ alone misses interaction: o_proj measured LESS sensitive than q_proj in isolation (-0.112 vs +0.239) and crushing it cost more inside a full allocation. Use a one-at-a-time map to rank candidates, never to build an allocation additively.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a negative delta that survives two corpora of different domain on the same organ, or a mechanism predicting WHICH corpus should show it
laws.text: NEGATIVE SENSITIVITY IS DEAD -- it was a corpus artifact. On the ML-domain corpus A, crushing o_proj (-0.1115) and gate_proj (-0.1010) from q4-g64 to q3-g64 IMPROVED perplexity. On corpus B (narrative/historical/biological, sharing only 8 function words with A) both flip firmly positive: o_proj +0.3837, gate_proj +0.6710, and NO organ has negative sensitivity. 'Beneficial Gravity' -- the hypothesis that stronger compression can improve the organism -- has no support from this evidence.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a sensitivity probe measured across multiple corpora whose consensus ordering beats the global anatomy order in a byte-exact depth-exact allocation on a corpus none of them was measured on
laws.text: One-at-a-time behavioural sensitivity DOES NOT TRANSFER ACROSS CORPORA, and is therefore not an allocation authority. The map measured on corpus A predicts the corpus B ordering at tau 0.4286 -- while the STATIC global anatomy order predicts corpus B sensitivity at tau 0.619, i.e. BETTER than the measured map does. Worse, in a byte-exact depth-exact allocation the map's negative control REVERSES SIGN between corpora: ANTI minus SENS is +0.6712 on A (map predicts) and -0.5145 on B (map predicts BACKWARDS). The apparent predictive power on the corpus it was measured on is in-sample fit. Note the structure of the failure: the SENSITIVE end is stable across corpora (down_proj 0.963/0.934 and v_proj 0.747/0.796 are top-two on both) while the TOLERANT end is what moves -- and allocation decisions hinge on the tolerant end, on what to crush.

laws.counterexample_requirement: a third corpus or a second body where a gentle depth-controlled tilt along the global order fails the conjunction while uniform passes; also owed is a per-group mirror at this budget, since GLOBAL and ANTI agree on {q,o} yet differ by 0.21 r4 on corpus B, so the mechanism is NOT isolated to one group
laws.text: The GLOBAL structural anatomy order TRANSFERS as an allocation policy. Across two corpora of different domain, at identical bytes (247,730,784) and an identical bit-depth multiset, GLOBAL_ANATOMY is the ONLY arm to pass the capability conjunction on BOTH: corpus A ppl 5.5520 r4 0.4135, corpus B ppl 4.9438 r4 0.4000. Its advantage is diversity and it is stable -- r4 ~0.40 on both corpora against UNIFORM's 0.7103 and 0.7308, a gap near 0.30 each time -- while UNIFORM holds the best likelihood on both and fails the gate on both. The tilt must be gentle and depth-controlled: arms whose ramp reached q2 landed at ppl 6.76-12.84.

scars.description: G012 damaged this law's PRESCRIPTION while leaving its measurement intact. LAW009 concluded 'use measured behavioural sensitivity, not anatomy, to allocate'. At matched bytes and matched bit depths the anatomy-ordered arm beat the sensitivity-ordered arm and was the only one to pass the conjunction. What survives: structure is a weak PAIRWISE predictor (3/5) and the per-MB tau inverts. What is refuted: the recommendation to allocate by the one-at-a-time map.
scars.reopen_when: an interaction-aware sensitivity measurement that beats the global order in a byte-exact, depth-exact allocation

scars.description: Corpus B refutes this law's premise as well as its prescription: the sensitivity map does not transfer, and on corpus B the static global order predicts measured sensitivity BETTER (tau 0.619) than the corpus-A map does (tau 0.4286). The 'structure barely predicts tolerance' reading was itself corpus-A-specific.
scars.reopen_when: a multi-corpus consensus sensitivity map that beats the global order out of sample

scars.description: Corpus B strengthens and supersedes the scope of this law. The failure is not only that the one-at-a-time map does not COMPOSE -- it does not TRANSFER: its negative control reverses sign between corpora.
scars.reopen_when: a multi-corpus consensus sensitivity map that beats the global order out of sample
